CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  June 10, 2025

  The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – June 10, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Ankit Udani, Vice Chairman; Michael
  Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – May 27, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the May 27, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the May 27, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Vice-Chair Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-022
  • 608 La Paloma Avenue
  • Applicant: Erick Molinar
  • Request: This is an application for a new 30” high front yard fence
  on an existing single-family residence.

  1
  06/10/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Provide a matte finish on the proposed front yard fence.
  2) Update the site plan to show new 36” wide gate, instead of door.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Vice-Chair Udani.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-080
  • 3071 West Valley Boulevard
  • Applicant: Juan Duran
  • Request: This is an application for a new 206 SF addition and
  exterior improvements to an existing 1-story commercial building,
  including a new accessible pedestrian ramp.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the site plan and renderings to accurately illustrate the
  existing conditions of the site fence height and style.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant shall either revise the site plan and renderings to
  accurately illustrate the existing conditions of the site fence
  including the picket style, or to show a new proposed fence
  material & style to be reviewed and approved by the City
  Architect.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-127
  • 425 South 4th Street
  • Applicant: Vered Nissan
  • Request: This is an application for exterior remodel to an existing 1-
  story Craftsman style single-family home.

  3
  06/10/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant to confirm on the east elevation that the exterior
  siding will extend around the gable vent.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant should update the east elevation to show the
  exterior siding extending around the gable vent.
  2) Revise the drafting error in elevation for location of roof vents.
  3) Update the elevations to show corner trim board at corner
  conditions.

  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 7:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-24-083
  • 2576 Loma Vista Drive
  • Applicant: Yunfei Yang
  • Request: This is an application for new construction of a 2,616 SF 2-
  story single-family dwelling in the front portion of an existing
  residential property.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant should provide a minimum of one roof line offset at
  least five feet in length along the east façade to comply with
  Section 23.13.020 of the Alhambra’s zoning code and work with
  the City Architect on the roof redesign and placement.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) The applicant should either provide a minimum of one roof line
  offset at least five feet in length along the east façade to comply
  with Section 23.13.020 of the Alhambra’s zoning code and work
  with the City Architect on the roof redesign and placement, or

  4
  06/10/2025
   reduce the east façade length to be less than 50 feet and avoid
  this Building Design Requirement.
  2) Remove the second-floor exterior lighting fixtures.
  3) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

AGENDA
ITEM 8:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-044
  • 2512 Hagen Drive
  • Applicant: Seth Sor
  • Request: This is an application for a 1,414 SF 2-story addition to the
  rear and exterior remodel including a new covered porch to an
  existing 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: CONTINUE - The proposed project is
  continued with the following design considerations:

  1) The applicant should continue to study the front porch design that
  aligns with the Ranch style character and features, such as a
  shed roof that embodies the main roof form.
  2) The applicant should revise the proposed stone material to be an
  authentic material that displays the ability to age in a manner
  similar to or superior to the natural material. Faux or fake
  materials are discouraged for exterior wall cladding.
  3) The applicant should provide further window details such as a trim
  and sill detail, and information on window grid style.
  4) The applicant should revise the color elevation to match the
  proposed exterior elevations.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to continue the application with the following design
  considerations:

  1) The applicant should select an architectural style that is
  compatible with the existing neighborhood and further define the
  characteristics of that style.
  2) The applicant should reference the Alhambra’s Residential
  Design Guidelines when selecting an architectural style.
  3) Should the applicant choose a Ranch architectural style for the
  project, the applicant should continue to study the front porch

  5
  06/10/2025
   design that aligns with the Ranch style character and features,
  such as a shed roof that embodies the main roof form.
  4) Should the applicant choose a Ranch architectural style for the
  project, the applicant should revise the proposed stone material
  to be an authentic material that displays the ability to age in a
  manner similar to or superior to the natural material. Faux or fake
  materials are discouraged for exterior wall cladding.
  5) The applicant should provide further window details such as a trim
  and sill detail, and information on window grid style.
  6) The applicant should revise the color elevation to match the
  proposed exterior elevations.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-0-0-0
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  None

E.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

F.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:28 P.M. to
  Tuesday, June 24, 2025, at 7:00 P.M.
